name: E4_1_indicbertv2_single_emotion
description: Single-task IndicBERT v2 (ai4bharat/IndicBERTv2-MLM-only) emotion, the encoder used by the indiDataMiner system at SemEval-2025 Task 11 (Hindi). Added after review to compare against a 2025 system on our splits; same protocol and hyperparameters as C_ST_emotion_muril. Pre-registered test.
